model.title: Model
model.description: The text-to-speech model name, e.g. tts-1 or tts-1-hd.

input.title: Text
input.description: The text to turn into speech.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice to use, e.g. alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, or shimmer.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Optional. Audio format: mp3 (default), opus, aac, flac, wav, or pcm.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Optional. Playback speed from 0.25 to 4.0. Defaults to 1.0.
